products.description:
Hitachi 1.5 Ton Inverter AC

The Hitachi RSQG018HFEOEZ1 1.5 Ton AC is designed for the 1.0TR tonnage class, has a rated and maximum cooling capacity up to 18000 BTU, or 5100 watts at full load, ensuring steady temperature management even during peak summer conditions. The Hitachi RSQG018HFEOEZ1 AC is powered by a high performance rotary compressor and runs on a normal 230V, 50Hz, single phase power supply. With a rated power input of only 1645 watts, it is an energy-efficient alternative. With a rated EER of 3.10, AEER of 3.04, and MEPS of 2.93, this Hitachi 1.5 Ton AC combines powerful cooling with low electricity consumption, requiring only 7.9 amps during rated operation. The indoor device provides powerful airflow of up to 583 CFM with three fan speed settings, while keeping a low interior noise level of 37 dB for calm comfort. Advanced Soft Dry technology keeps the evaporator coil dry even after shutting down, eliminating moisture buildup, dust, and pollen for cleaner air. The Hitachi RSQG018HFEOEZ1 1.5 Ton Inverter AC features wave Blade Design technology, which uses sine wave blades and a bigger blower to reduce air cutting noise while throwing air farther. The clever Penta Sensor constantly analyzes conditions to improve cooling and safeguard key components. Stepless compressor control adjusts speed smoothly for continuous comfort. Built with 100% inner grooved copper tubing, the Hitachi AC ensures faster heat transmission, corrosion resistance, and a longer lifespan, making the Hitachi RSQG018HFEOEZ1 1.5 Ton Inverter AC a reliable solution for efficient everyday cooling.

products.name: Hitachi 2 Ton Inverter AC
products.description:
Hitachi 2 Ton Inverter AC

The Hitachi RMQG024HFEOEZ1 AC is a 2.0TR system with a maximum cooling capacity of 24000 BTU, or 6300 watts at full load, ensuring quick and uniform temperature management even during high heat. The Hitachi RMQG024HFEOEZ1 AC is powered by a high efficiency rotary compressor and runs on a 230V, 50Hz, single phase power supply. It has a rated power input of 2000 watts and a rated current draw of 9.2 amp. The Hitachi 2 Ton Inverter AC, with an EER of 3.15, AEER of 3.1, and MEPS rating of 2.93, strikes a balance between powerful cooling performance and efficient energy consumption. The indoor device delivers a powerful airflow of up to 583 CFM across three fan speed settings while maintaining a low indoor noise level of only 38 dB for comfortable operation. Soft Dry technology keeps the indoor fan running shortly after shutdown to dry accumulated moisture on the evaporator coil, reducing dust, pollen, and debris buildup and providing cleaner air. Wave Blade Design technique employs sine wave blades and a bigger blower to reduce air cutting noise while providing extended airflow. The clever Penta Sensor monitors indoor and outdoor conditions to optimise cooling under load changes and safeguard critical components. Stepless compressor control regulates compressor speed constantly, providing smooth, uninterrupted comfort. Built with 100 percent inner grooved copper tubing, the Hitachi AC enhances heat transfer, resists corrosion, and extends system life, making the Hitachi RMQG024HFEOEZ1 2 Ton Inverter AC a dependable cooling solution for modern homes seeking efficient performance, quiet operation, durable construction, advanced sensing technology, consistent airflow, reliable summer comfort, and trusted brand quality from Hitachi AC systems worldwide.
